frames.0: horizontal tile, period 10 px (TileSprite height 10, tile in x)
frames.1: vertical tile, period 10 px (TileSprite width 10, tile in y) - hook rain chains
frames.2-5: face link stamp (5x3 + outline) at 0 / 45 / 90 / 135 deg
frames.6-9: edge link stamp (3x2 + outline) at 0 / 45 / 90 / 135 deg

any_angle: stamp links along the line every 5 px alternating face (2-5) / edge (6-9), picking the stamp whose angle is nearest the chain direction (mod 180); no rotation of pixels needed. For -10..+35 deg throws frames 2/6 (0 deg) and 3/7 (45 deg) cover it.
